heading: More
intro: You don't need anything here for everyday use. Come here to see how the agent works, or to adjust it.

memory.title: What it remembers
memory.description: What you told it and what it guessed. Delete anything.

skills.title: Methods it uses
skills.description: How it breaks down goals and estimates time. All swappable.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.description: Find out whether a way of working suits you

history.title: Change history
history.description: Everything the agent changed, and a way to undo it

memory.intro: What you told it and what it guessed are kept apart. If a guess is wrong, delete it and it won't be used again.

skills.intro: These are the methods the agent uses when it plans for you. No method suits everyone, so turn off any that don't fit.
skills.tip: To change the details, just tell the agent, for example “count my commute when you estimate time”.
skills.proposal: The agent wants to change this method

experiments.intro: Want to know whether something works for you? The agent alternates two kinds of weeks and tells you what it found.

adopt.label: Plan this way for two weeks
adopt.reply: OK. The next two weeks follow this, and I'll ask how it felt afterward.

rerun.label: Test again
rerun.reply: OK, two more weeks. This time I'll keep the number of meetings about the same in both.

drop.label: Not interested
drop.reply: OK, dropping it. The results stay in the record.

history.intro: Everything the agent changed is here. Undo puts things back the way they were. Your own edits are never undone.
history.retried_one: Took {{count}} retry to get the format right
history.retried_other: Took {{count}} retries to get the format right
history.claimedWithoutChange: A check caught this, and the next retry worked

connections.intro: Once connected, calendar events show up on the Calendar page, and runs and flashcard reviews count as done automatically.
connections.outside: Content from outside is marked with where it came from and kept apart from what you say, so it never becomes instructions for the agent.
connections.local: What it reads stays in the workspace on this computer. Jezo doesn't send it anywhere else.
connections.browser: Your browser opens next so you can sign in.
